subject: Intrinsic functions
notes: LANDED (kb/Work PB124 wave 1): the last three order-free keyword walks are now POSITIONAL. BindTrim: [LEADING|TRAILING] only after argument-1, before every argument-2, once (15.96.2's figure notes confirm the bracket's position - and the vendor-habit TRIM(LEADING x) is NOT the ISO order; pb117_trim_sequential itself carried it and was corrected). BindLengthFamily: PHYSICAL is the keyword ONLY in its slot (after argument-1, last, once) - it is not a reserved word, so LENGTH(PHYSICAL) now measures a data item NAMED PHYSICAL where the old swallow consumed the user's name (the golden pins both readings). BindSubstitute: [ANYCASE] [FIRST|LAST] in the printed order, before the pair, no repeats, none between argument-2 and argument-3. Negative fixtures pin the mis-ordered/repeated/mid-pair shapes for the first time (the row's charge).
